name: Sneak Attack
trigger: You hit with a finesse or ranged weapon
description: Once per turn, add the Sneak Attack dice as extra damage to one creature you hit. The attack must use a finesse or ranged weapon, and you need either advantage on the attack roll, or another enemy of the target within 5 ft of it that is not incapacitated, with you having no disadvantage on the roll.

name: Cunning Action
description: Each turn you have a bonus action that can be used only for Dash, Disengage or Hide.

name: Uncanny Dodge
trigger: An attacker you can see hits you
description: When an attacker you can see hits you, use your reaction to halve the damage of that attack.

name: Stroke of Luck
trigger: Your attack misses, or you fail an ability check
description: A missed attack against a target in range becomes a hit. Or a failed ability check counts as a natural 20 on the d20.
Needs a short or long rest before it can be used again.

name: Fast Hands
description: Your Cunning Action bonus action can pay for any of these: a Sleight of Hand check, disarming a trap or opening a lock with thieves' tools, or the Use an Object action.

name: Thief's Reflexes
trigger: Round 1 of a fight
description: Combat's opening round gives you an extra turn: act once on your usual initiative count, then again 10 counts lower. Being surprised cancels this.

name: Assassinate
trigger: Attacking a foe that hasn't acted yet
description: Strike first and hard. Until a creature has had its first turn of the fight, your attack rolls against it have advantage. Against a surprised creature, every hit you land counts as a critical hit.

name: Death Strike
trigger: You hit a surprised creature
description: Hit a surprised creature and it must pass a Constitution save. The DC is 8, plus your proficiency bonus, plus your Dexterity modifier. If it fails, your attack deals double damage.

name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
description: You always know mage hand as an Arcane Trickster. Cast it and the hand can be invisible. It can also stow an item into someone else's container, fetch one out, or pick locks and disarm traps from a distance using thieves' tools.
Beat the creature's Wisdom (Perception) with a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check and these tasks go unnoticed. Controlling the hand takes your Cunning Action bonus action.

name: Magical Ambush
trigger: You cast a spell on a creature while hidden from it
description: Cast a spell at a creature that can't see you (you are hidden from it) and that creature has disadvantage on its saves against the spell for the rest of the turn.

name: Versatile Trickster
description: Use your mage hand to distract. Pick a creature within 5 ft of the hand. You have advantage on attack rolls against it until the end of this turn.

name: Spell Thief
trigger: A spell targets you or catches you in its area
description: Right after the spell is cast, spend your reaction: the caster saves with its spellcasting ability modifier against your spell save DC.

If it fails, the spell does nothing to you. A spell of level 1 or higher that you have slots for (any class's list) is now yours for 8 hours, cast with your own slots, while the caster loses the use of it for those 8 hours.
Recharges on a long rest.

name: Fancy Footwork
trigger: You make a melee attack on your turn
description: On your turn, any creature you make a melee attack against, hit or miss, can't make opportunity attacks against you until your turn ends.

name: Rakish Audacity
trigger: You attack a lone foe next to you
description: Add your Charisma modifier to your initiative rolls.

You can also Sneak Attack without advantage, provided the target is within 5 ft of you, nobody else is within 5 ft of you, and the attack roll isn't at disadvantage. All the usual Sneak Attack rules still apply.

name: Panache
description: Action: roll Charisma (Persuasion) against the target's Wisdom (Insight). The target must hear you and share a language with you.

Hostile creature, you win: for 1 minute its attack rolls against anyone but you have disadvantage, and it can make opportunity attacks only against you. It ends early if one of your companions attacks it or affects it with a spell, or if you and it end up more than 60 ft apart.
Non-hostile creature, you win: for 1 minute you have it charmed, and it sees you as a friendly acquaintance. Harming it in any way, by you or your companions, ends the charm at once.

name: Elegant Maneuver
description: Bonus action: your next Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check this turn is made with advantage.

name: Master Duelist
trigger: You miss with an attack roll
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Roll the missed attack again, with advantage.

name: Eye for Detail
description: Bonus action: roll a Wisdom (Perception) check to find a hidden creature or object, or an Intelligence (Investigation) check to work out or read clues.

name: Insightful Fighting
description: Bonus action: choose a creature in sight that isn't incapacitated and pit your Wisdom (Insight) check against its Charisma (Deception) check.

If you win, for 1 minute you can Sneak Attack that creature even when you lack advantage on the attack roll, though never while you have disadvantage. A later success against a new target ends it early.

name: Unerring Eye
uses: Wisdom modifier times (at least once) per long rest
description: Action, as long as you aren't blinded or deafened: you notice any illusions, shapechangers wearing a false form, and other senses-fooling magic within 30 ft of you.
You learn only that something is deceiving you, not what it conceals or what it really is.

name: Eye for Weakness
trigger: You Sneak Attack the target of your Insightful Fighting
description: While Insightful Fighting covers a creature, add 3d6 to your Sneak Attack damage against it.

name: Master of Tactics
description: You can take the Help action as a bonus action.
When your Help aids an ally's attack, the creature being attacked may be up to 30 ft away from you instead of 5 ft, provided it can see or hear you.

name: Insightful Manipulator
description: Outside combat, watch or talk with a creature for 1 minute or more. Then pick two of these: its Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma score, or its class levels (if it has any). For each, the DM tells you if it is higher than, lower than or equal to yours.
The DM may also reveal a fact from its past, or a personality trait if it has one.

name: Misdirection
trigger: Something attacks you while you have cover from a creature at most 5 ft away
description: Make the attack target the creature providing your cover instead of you.

name: Skirmisher
trigger: An enemy finishes its turn 5 ft or less from you
description: Move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Ambush Master
trigger: You roll initiative, or you hit your first creature in the first round of a combat
description: Every time you roll initiative, you roll it with advantage.
The first creature you hit during a combat's opening round is left exposed: every attack roll against it, from anyone, has advantage until your next turn starts.

name: Sudden Strike
description: On a turn when you take the Attack action, one extra attack is yours as a bonus action.
That attack can deal Sneak Attack damage even if you already did so this turn, but one target can't take your Sneak Attack twice in a turn.

name: Steady Aim
description: Usable only if you haven't moved yet this turn: your next attack roll this turn has advantage.
Once you use it, your speed is 0 for the rest of the turn.

name: Whispers of the Dead
trigger: You finish a short or long rest
description: Pick one skill or tool proficiency you don't have and gain it. It stays until a later rest where you trade it for a different one.

name: Wails from the Grave
trigger: Your Sneak Attack has just damaged a creature, on your turn
description: Pick a second visible creature no more than 30 ft from the first. Roll half your Sneak Attack dice (round up); it takes that much necrotic damage.
Level 9 (Tokens of the Departed): destroy a soul trinket you carry to use this without spending a use.
Level 17 (Death's Friend): the first creature takes the necrotic damage too.

name: Tokens of the Departed
trigger: A visible creature dies no more than 30 ft away
description: Hold out a free hand: a soul trinket, a Tiny object made from the departing life, forms there. The DM decides its look, or you roll on the Trinkets table (PHB).
You can own at most your proficiency bonus in soul trinkets; at that cap, no new one forms.
Always on: while you carry a trinket, you have advantage on death saves and Constitution saves.

Spending one: when your Sneak Attack deals damage on your turn, destroy a trinket you carry for a free Wails from the Grave; or destroy one as an action to question its spirit (Tokens of the Departed (Question)).
Level 17 (Death's Friend): if you have no trinket when a long rest ends, one appears in your hand.

name: Tokens of the Departed (Question)
description: Destroy one of your soul trinkets, wherever it is, and ask its spirit a single question.
The spirit shows up and replies in a language it spoke while alive. It knows only what it knew then (the DM decides), and it needn't be truthful, but it answers briefly, keen to be released.

name: Ghost Walk
uses: Once per long rest, or destroy a soul trinket
description: Take a spectral form for 10 minutes: a 10 ft flying speed with hover, and attack rolls against you have disadvantage.
Creatures and objects no longer block you, though moving through them counts as difficult terrain; ending your turn inside one deals you 1d10 force damage.
End it early as a bonus action. To use it again before a long rest, destroy a soul trinket when you take the bonus action to start it.

name: Psionic Power
description: Your psionic powers run on a pool of Psionic Energy dice: twice your proficiency bonus of them. A power that needs a die is unusable while the pool is empty.
The whole pool comes back when you finish a long rest. Once per short or long rest you can also win back a single die as a bonus action (Psionic Power (Regain)).
Die size grows with rogue level: d6, then d8 at 5, d10 at 11 and d12 at 17.
Powers: Psi-Bolstered Knack and Psychic Whispers; Soul Blades (level 9) adds Homing Strikes and Psychic Teleportation. Psychic Veil and Rend Mind can also spend dice.

name: Psionic Power (Regain)
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Get back one spent Psionic Energy die.

name: Psi-Bolstered Knack
trigger: You fail an ability check with a skill or tool you are proficient in
resource: 1 Psionic Energy die (spent only if the check then succeeds)
description: Roll a Psionic Energy die and add it to the check, which may turn it into a success. The die is used up only when the check succeeds.

name: Psychic Whispers
resource: 1 Psionic Energy die (not spent on the first use after each long rest)
description: Link minds with creatures you can see, up to your proficiency bonus in number. Roll a Psionic Energy die: for that many hours, you and they can talk telepathically.

Sending or hearing a message takes no action but needs both ends within 1 mile. No shared language is needed, though a creature that knows no language can't use the link. Any of them can drop out at any time, with no action.
The first use after each long rest leaves the die unspent; every later use spends it.

name: Psychic Blades
trigger: You take the Attack action
description: Make an attack with a psychic blade formed in your free hand: a magic simple melee weapon with finesse and thrown (60 ft range, no long range). On a hit: 1d6 psychic + the modifier you attacked with.
The blade vanishes right after the attack, hit or miss, and leaves no mark on a target it damages.
After this attack you can make a second blade attack as a bonus action (Psychic Blades (Bonus Attack)).

name: Psychic Blades (Bonus Attack)
description: Swing or throw a second psychic blade: one weapon attack, with a damage die of 1d4 instead of 1d6.
Needs your other hand free, and a psychic blade attack earlier this turn.

name: Homing Strikes
trigger: Your Psychic Blades attack misses
resource: 1 Psionic Energy die (spent only if the attack then hits)
description: Roll a Psionic Energy die and add it to the attack roll. The die is used up only if the attack now hits.

name: Psychic Teleportation
description: Spend and roll a Psionic Energy die, then hurl a psychic blade at an empty space you can see, up to 10 times the roll in feet away. You teleport there and the blade disappears.

name: Psychic Veil
resource: 1 Psionic Energy die (after the free use)
description: Turn invisible, along with everything you wear or carry, for 1 hour or until you drop it (no action needed).
It ends at once when you damage a creature or force one to make a saving throw.
The first use is free; using it again before a long rest costs a Psionic Energy die.

name: Rend Mind
trigger: Sneak Attack damage lands through your Psychic Blades
resource: 3 Psionic Energy dice (after the free use)
description: The target makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier) or is stunned for 1 minute. It may save again as each of its turns ends; a success ends the stun.
The first use is free; using it again before a long rest costs three Psionic Energy dice.
